ckBannerText: We use cookies and browser storage that the booking system needs to work, and ask for your consent to remember your preferences, in line with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019).
ckNecessaryDesc: Needed for the website to work and cannot be switched off: the anti-bot security check (Cloudflare Turnstile), remembering your booking reference and help-chat conversation while the tab is open, remembering this consent choice, and storing site files on your device so pages load faster.
ckPreferencesDesc: Remembers your language and dark-mode choice, keeps a temporary copy of the prisoner list for faster search, and remembers "Don't show again today" on the announcement popup.
ckAnalyticsDesc: Measures site usage to improve the service. The website does not use this type of cookie at present, and will not enable it without your consent.
ckPolicyTitle: Cookie and personal data protection policy
ckPolicy1: Cookies and browser storage (such as Local Storage and Session Storage) are small pieces of data the website saves on your device so the system can work and remember your settings.
ckPolicy2: When you make a choice we record a random consent ID, your choice, the policy version, your language, browser type and a hash of your IP address (the actual IP address is not stored) as evidence of consent, and delete it after 2 years.
ckPolicy3: Personal data you enter in the booking form is used to process your booking, check your eligibility to take part, and inform you of the result.
ckPolicy4: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via "Cookie settings" at the bottom of the page, without affecting the necessary functions. We ask again every 12 months or whenever the policy is updated.

homeAgency: Department of Corrections · Central Correctional Institution for Drug Addicts
homeStepsSub: Follow every step on the "Check Status" page with your reference number (Ref No.)
homeStep1T: Fill in details and pick a date
homeStep1D: Enter participant details, find the prisoner and pick an available date. You get a reference number immediately.
homeStep3D: The prisoner's discipline record is checked. Both checks take about 1–2 working days.
homeStep4D: When the status is "Awaiting payment", scan the QR code on the status page and upload your slip.
homeStep5D: Show your original ID card and follow the institution's rules.
homePriceSub: Visit bookings are paid only after approval
homeRule1: Show your original ID card (passport for foreign nationals)
homeRule2: Mobile phones are not allowed in the visiting area
homeFaq1Q: How far ahead can I book, and why can't I pick some dates?
homeFaq1A: You can book from tomorrow up to {n} days ahead, Monday to Friday only. Dates you can't pick are public holidays, dates closed for booking, or full dates ({q} bookings per day).
homeFaq2Q: How long does the review take?
homeFaq2A: Usually 1–2 working days. Follow the result on the "Check Status" page with your reference number or the prisoner's ID number.
homeFaq3A: When the status is "Awaiting payment", the status page shows a PromptPay QR code for that booking. Scan it with your banking app, then upload the slip for staff to confirm.
homeFaq4A: Yes, on the status page. Cancellation cannot be undone; to come another day, please make a new booking.
homeFaq5Q: Can I book a visit with a prisoner under disciplinary restriction?
homeFaq5A: No. The system tells you when a prisoner is barred from visits for disciplinary reasons, and accepts bookings again once the period ends.
homeFaq6Q: How is a table booking different from a visit booking?
homeFaq6A: A table booking is for outside guests dining without a prisoner at the table. It needs no review, you pay right after booking, and payment must be made within {min} minutes or the table is released.
homeFaq7Q: I forgot my reference number (Ref No.). What can I do?
homeFaq7A: Search with the prisoner's ID number on the "Check Status" page.
homeFaq8Q: How is my personal data used?
homeFaq8A: Form data is used to process your booking, check eligibility and inform you of the result. See "Cookie settings" at the bottom of the page for details.
